# SkiaSharp capability inventory — 0.75

<!-- Generated by tools/api-inventory.py --write. Edit api/*.json, not this report. -->

Baseline: `b07cddd379efe17aa729e4c68b14f842a8d7cc7f`. Comparison: SkiaSharp **3.119.1**, Skia m119 at `40f75dc0051d141913c07c20d4c19590c7da0cb7`.

## Scope and evidence

**140 capability families; 849 core C function declarations; 86 managed source files; 53 public Racket modules.**
The baseline expects **639 distinct bindings** across **nine registries**, including **581 CPU bindings**. These are not feature-completion percentages.

Each scoped C declaration has exactly one primary disposition. Managed files map to one or more capability families; this does **not** classify every C# overload, property, enum value, platform UI package, or Skia add-on. Normalized C declarations are pinned inputs; the explicit upstream-checkout gate verifies their source bytes and names.

`missing-available-abi` means a declaration exists in the pinned C interface, not that a particular native binary exports or implements it. `supported-with-limits` and `racket-equivalent` are reviewed source declarations. They do not certify every overload, backend, format, or pixel result.

Historical baseline evidence retains a Linux aggregate symbol audit, **not** a per-symbol exported list. A fresh optional child-process probe records resolution for all scoped functions with exact library hash, ABI and invocation identity. Resolution of a stub still does not prove execution. No native/rendering result is invented by generating this report.

See [API decisions](API-DESIGN-DECISIONS.md) for the additive image-info/color/lease design and [maintenance](../api/README.md) for scope, drift checks and validation commands.

<a id="canvas-float-color"></a>
### canvas.float-color — Floating-color clear and color drawing

**supported-with-limits**; next stage: **none scheduled**; origin: `m119`.

Native Color4f clear/draw use the reviewed 16-byte by-value ABI and sRGB interpretation. Finite extended RGB is not prequantized by the wrapper. Actual target formats constrain results; current GPU targets remain RGBA8888 and do not establish HDR presentation.

**Document behavior:** Float-color and float-pixel provenance requires explicit quantization or declared rasterization for strict PDF/SVG. The acceptance fixtures retain raw float samples, explicitly convert to RGBA8888, then require one embedded image with surrounding vector marker and hyperlink. No silent precision loss is classified as vector output.

**Backend declaration:** F16/F32 CPU storage and drawing; float operations can draw to existing RGBA8888 GPU targets. Generalized GPU formats and physical HDR remain separate stages. Tests here are source references, not per-backend execution receipts.

**Public source anchors:** `float-colors.rkt:canvas-clear-color4f!`, `float-colors.rkt:draw-color4f`.

<a id="canvas-layer-record"></a>
### canvas.layer-record — Full layer record / backdrop control

**supported-with-limits**; next stage: **none scheduled**; origin: `m119`.

Checked pinned SaveLayerRec bounds, paint, backdrop and LCD/initialize-previous/F16 flags. Options are detached; paint/backdrop ownership is validated at use. The scoped helper pins its owner, protects restore floors and installs an optional real clip. Bounds remain native allocation/content hints, not a reliable clipping API. Exceptions restore state and composite existing layer content; no pixel rollback.

**Document behavior:** Plain recorded drawables preserve native vector replay and retained dependency features. Advanced backdrop/initialization/LCD/F16 layers require explicit rasterization including needed backdrop; discard is classified as semantic loss. Diagnostic wrappers are not PDF/SVG targets or substitute raster-group authority.

**Backend declaration:** Ordinary raster and same-domain Ganesh OpenGL/Metal/Direct3D drawing. NWay requires same-backend owned targets; Alpha8 overdraw needs native format support. NoDraw has no output pixels. Source references are not execution receipts; selected backend acceptance is separate from physical display/HDR verification.

**Public source anchors:** `advanced-layers.rkt:canvas-save-layer-rec!`, `advanced-layers.rkt:call-with-canvas-layer-rec`, `layer-options.rkt:make-layer-options`.

<a id="canvas-specialized"></a>
### canvas.specialized — No-draw, N-way and overdraw canvases

**supported-with-limits**; next stage: **none scheduled**; origin: `m119`.

Callback-scoped native canvases. NWay accepts 1..64 distinct same-sized owned surfaces with compatible root state and the same execution backend/domain; original targets are exclusively borrowed. No arbitrary borrowed document/recording canvas fan-out. Overdraw requires Alpha8 and direct primitives; text, pictures/drawables and layers reject rather than reaching unsupported native transformed-text paths. Counts are native approximations, not hardware fragment statistics. No diagnostic canvas can replace an audited bounded raster target.

**Document behavior:** Plain recorded drawables preserve native vector replay and retained dependency features. Advanced backdrop/initialization/LCD/F16 layers require explicit rasterization including needed backdrop; discard is classified as semantic loss. Diagnostic wrappers are not PDF/SVG targets or substitute raster-group authority.

### pictures.drawables — Retained drawable objects and canvas placement

**supported-with-limits**; next stage: **none scheduled**; origin: `m119`.

Real native SkRecordedDrawable creation from an immutable captured picture, retained/immediate placement, detached bounds/size/generation metadata and native picture snapshots. Authoring executes once. Generation invalidation is not command mutation. User callback-backed or externally mutable native drawables are not exposed; no Racket callback crosses native replay frames. Retained GPU affinity and output features survive source closure and snapshot conversion.

<a id="paint-float-color"></a>
### paint.float-color — Color4f paint values

**supported-with-limits**; next stage: **none scheduled**; origin: `m119`.

Separate finite unpremultiplied Color4f values; explicit non-null source-space descriptors. SkPaint stores and returns extended sRGB. Integer setters and legacy packed colors remain unchanged. Copies/reset/replacement preserve or clear precision provenance explicitly.

**Document behavior:** Float-color and float-pixel provenance requires explicit quantization or declared rasterization for strict PDF/SVG. The acceptance fixtures retain raw float samples, explicitly convert to RGBA8888, then require one embedded image with surrounding vector marker and hyperlink. No silent precision loss is classified as vector output.

<a id="paint-fill-query"></a>

**supported-with-limits**; next stage: **none scheduled**; origin: `m119`.

**supported-with-limits**; next stage: **0.75b**; origin: `m119`.

0.75a typeface input consumes a private native duplicate starting at zero and retains its needed storage independently of the original wrapper. TTC indices are checked. The named port path is fully buffered, not a live callback stream. Prior family limits: No general promise of byte-identical output across platforms or backends.

**Document behavior:** No streamed document publication is added in 0.75a. Existing buffered PDF/SVG exporters and audit policy are unchanged; pictures deserialized from streams retain opaque imported provenance. Port write failure can leave a partial buffered prefix, not an atomic publication guarantee.

**Backend declaration:** CPU native resources on the pinned platform builds; no GPU/GUI initialization, implicit GPU readback or native callback bridge. Source/test anchors are not execution evidence. File-backed consumers require a stable backing file.

<a id="fonts-path-position"></a>
### fonts.path-position — Path-positioned glyph outlines

**supported-with-limits**; next stage: **none scheduled**; origin: `m119`.

Checked glyph IDs and explicit XY positions feed the pinned glyph-ID SkTextUtils route. The returned path is independently owned and contains available monochrome outlines only; missing bitmap/color-only outlines are not reconstructed. This unshaped utility is separate from shaped text-on-path.

**Document behavior:** Native PDF text preservation is tested for ordinary multi-font runs with valid text/cluster mappings. RSXform/path-text vector export uses explicit outlines; it is not promised searchable. New blob outline conversion rejects visibly bounded glyphs lacking outlines. No hidden raster fallback.

**Backend declaration:** Raster and existing OpenGL/Metal/Direct3D routes; CPU-independent snapshots. Fresh native, GPU and independent PDF/SVG execution is required separately.

<a id="text-blob-runs"></a>
### text.blob-runs — Multi-run, horizontal, RSXform and text/cluster blob builders

**supported-with-limits**; next stage: **none scheduled**; origin: `m119`.

Single-use owned builder; default, horizontal, XY and RSXform runs retain private font snapshots. Input glyphs, placements and optional UTF-8/scalar-start byte clusters are copied. Empty runs validate then add nothing; empty finish returns #f. Appends become terminal on native allocation/fill failure. Path text samples one explicitly selected contour using shaped positions, without rekerning, character-to-glyph assumptions, clipping or wrapping. Original shaped-run/shaper identity remains the caller responsibility.

**Document behavior:** Native PDF text preservation is tested for ordinary multi-font runs with valid text/cluster mappings. RSXform/path-text vector export uses explicit outlines; it is not promised searchable. New blob outline conversion rejects visibly bounded glyphs lacking outlines. No hidden raster fallback.

**Backend declaration:** Raster and existing OpenGL/Metal/Direct3D routes; CPU-independent snapshots. Fresh native, GPU and independent PDF/SVG execution is required separately.

**supported-with-limits**; next stage: **none scheduled**; origin: `m119`.

**supported-with-limits**; next stage: **none scheduled**; origin: `m119`.

**Document behavior:** Materialized integer filter/read results are intentional embedded raster images, not vector geometry. Preserve float precision provenance until explicit conversion/rasterization. Raw image shaders require explicit bounded rasterization for PDF/SVG. Document acceptance checks one image, surrounding vectors, hyperlinks, valid dimensions and geometric placement independently.

**supported-with-limits**; next stage: **0.75b**; origin: `m119`.

0.75a picture input synchronously borrows a private duplicate, keeps trust/header checks and unknown imported-SKP audit provenance, and returns an independent picture. It adds no mutable/callback-backed drawable or streamed output. Prior family limits: No general promise of byte-identical output across platforms or backends.

**Document behavior:** No streamed document publication is added in 0.75a. Existing buffered PDF/SVG exporters and audit policy are unchanged; pictures deserialized from streams retain opaque imported provenance. Port write failure can leave a partial buffered prefix, not an atomic publication guarantee.

**Backend declaration:** CPU native resources on the pinned platform builds; no GPU/GUI initialization, implicit GPU readback or native callback bridge. Source/test anchors are not execution evidence. File-backed consumers require a stable backing file.

**Public source anchors:** `stream-inputs.rkt:picture-from-stream`, `stream-inputs.rkt:picture-from-port/buffered`.

<a id="streams-native-ports"></a>
### streams.native-ports — Live native streams and Racket port adapters

**supported-with-limits**; next stage: **none scheduled**; origin: `m119`.

Operation-scoped pure Racket CS FFI; no compiler or extra native library. Six Xamarin managed-callback symbols outside include/c are separately declared in api/live-stream-ffi.json. Native callback dispatch is atomic but port I/O runs on a protected Racket service thread. One operation/provider/place at a time. Live decode returns an independent image; retained codec/typeface ports remain buffered/native-stream only. Native output is exclusively leased and poisoned on failure. Document recording precedes audited publication; named destinations and rich metadata use existing exporters. Partial output is possible. Logical limits do not bound total process/native memory. No arbitrary native pointer ingress.

**Document behavior:** Recorded commands are audited before streamed PDF/SVG publication without repeating authoring. URLs are retained; named destinations and rich metadata use existing exporters. Partial output is possible; existing buffered/atomic publication and opaque imported-SKP provenance remain unchanged.

**Backend declaration:** 64-bit Racket CS with OS threads on the pinned platform builds. CPU native operations only; GPU-affine inputs require explicit detachment. Protected service-thread port callbacks; process-global tables require one provider/place.
